findings.detail: All five flagged positions are floating-rate instruments because the source states S + spread; the fixed-rate classification is wrong while basis_spread is valid.

rationale: X04 localized five rows with basis_spread 5.75 or 6.50. The matching raw schedule rows explicitly disclose S + 5.75% PIK for Sweep Purchaser and S + 6.50% PIK for four Volt Bidco positions. S denotes a floating reference rate, so basis_spread is source-supported and the contradictory fixed-rate classification is the data defect.
